eraseData.title: Erase All Data
eraseData.warningBody: Erasing will permanently delete all accounts, assets, snapshots, and transactions from this device, the cloud, and every other synced device. This cannot be undone.
eraseData.resetSettingsLabel: Also reset app settings to defaults
eraseData.doneBody: All data has been permanently deleted and the change has been pushed to the cloud.

reconcile.title: Check Profit Differences
reconcile.help: Compare profit with current net worth minus the previous recorded net worth and current inflow. The first record is excluded; gaps use the previous record. Manual profits may use a different basis. Review before applying; an automatic backup is saved.
reconcile.confirm: Apply the preview to {{count}} profit records? Net worth and inflow are preserved.
reconcile.stale: Records changed. Please review the refreshed preview.
reconcile.offer: Later records have profit differences. Open a preview?
